Compose a heavy metal song in raga Darbari at 128 BPM, in the key of E (Sa = E4), for four parts: sitar (the lead melody), distorted rhythm guitar, bass guitar and a drum kit. Make it about 1 minute long (about 128 beats), with every part playing for the whole length. Return ONLY a JSON object with four keys, each a list of events in time order whose beats add up to the length of the song:
  "sitar":  [{"note": "<scientific pitch like E4, or rest>", "beats": <duration>, "vel": <1-127>}]
  "guitar": [{"notes": ["<pitch>", ...] (one pitch, a chord, or [] for a rest), "beats": <duration>, "vel": <1-127>}]
  "bass":   [{"note": "<pitch or rest>", "beats": <duration>, "vel": <1-127>}]
  "drums":  [{"hits": ["kick" | "snare" | "hihat" | "open_hihat" | "crash" | "ride" | "tom_hi" | "tom_mid" | "tom_lo", ...] ([] for a rest), "beats": <duration>, "vel": <1-127>}]

Raga Darbari's grammar (follow it):
- Allowed notes, sargam(pitch): S(E) R(F#) g(G) m(A) P(B) d(C) n(D). No other notes.
- Aroha, the ascent: S R g m P d n S
- Avaroha, the descent: S d n P m P g m R S
- Vadi (most important note): R; samvadi (its partner): P
- Pakad (signature phrases): S R g R g m P | d n P m P g m R S
- Chalan (characteristic movements): g m R S | m P d n P | n P m P g m R S
- Andolan (slow oscillation) on: g, d
Sargam: S Sa, r komal Re, R Re, g komal Ga, G Ga, m Ma, M tivra Ma, P Pa, d komal Dha, D Dha, n komal Ni, N Ni.
